reports.verdict: Cloud growth doubled, but record spending and negative cash flow spooked investors.

reasons.label: Cash burn
reasons.text: Free cash flow was negative $9.1 billion as spending outran cash from operations.

reasons.label: Huge AI spending
reasons.text: Capex reached $51.4 billion for the quarter, more than double last year's $24.0 billion.

reasons.label: Rising costs
reasons.text: Research costs rose 36% and borrowing costs climbed; debt more than doubled to $125 billion this year.

reports.verdict: Investors cheered sales and traffic beating forecasts, shrugging off weaker profit margins.

reasons.label: Sales beat forecasts
reasons.text: Same-store sales rose 2.1%, versus about 1.5% expected and roughly 1% guided.

reasons.label: Customers still returning
reasons.text: Third straight quarter of more transactions, up 0.8%, which suggests the turnaround is holding.

reasons.label: Profit squeeze, expected
reasons.text: Earnings per share slipped to $0.27 from $0.29 as margins fell, but analysts had expected it.

reports.verdict: Cloud growth sped up and spending came in lower than feared, so shares rose.

reasons.label: Azure growth accelerated
reasons.text: Azure revenue grew 48%, above the 44%–45% range Microsoft had guided.

reasons.label: Lower AI spending
reasons.text: Capex was about $39.4B, below the $45.9B analysts expected; lease accounting may flatter it.

reasons.label: Beat on revenue, profit
reasons.text: Revenue of $92.3B and adjusted EPS of $4.89 topped forecasts of $90.6B and $4.73.

reports.verdict: Earnings missed estimates and sales fell, so shares slipped modestly.

reasons.label: Profit fell short
reasons.text: Adjusted earnings were $9.36 a share, down from $10.45 a year ago and below forecasts of about $11.

reasons.label: Sales keep shrinking
reasons.text: Revenue fell 6.7% to $5.4 billion; used-car sales volume dropped 10.5%.

reasons.label: Debt load after Hennessy
reasons.text: Buying 10 Atlanta stores adds debt; about $360 million of store sales should help pay it down.

reports.verdict: Profit beat estimates, but a thin guidance raise and falling sales left shares slightly lower.

reasons.label: Modest guidance raise
reasons.text: Only the low end of 2026 profit guidance rose, to $10.5-11 billion from $10-11 billion.

reasons.label: Fewer vehicles sold
reasons.text: Vehicles sold fell 9% to 1.05 million, and revenue slipped 2% to $49.5 billion.

reasons.label: Weaker core profits
reasons.text: Gas-car profit fell 10% and commercial-truck profit fell 16%, on higher metal costs and launch costs.

reports.verdict: Investors sold hard on a wider loss and a slower 737 production ramp.

reasons.label: 737 ramp slower
reasons.text: Boeing cut its 2026 737 delivery target; 52 jets a month now seen only late 2027.

reasons.label: Bigger loss than expected
reasons.text: Adjusted loss was $0.34 a share versus about $0.25 expected, with plane unit losing $697 million.

reasons.label: Cash recovery delayed
reasons.text: Free cash flow was only $0.5 billion; the year to date is still $359 million negative.

reports.verdict: Investors cheered a second guidance raise and growing profit in the U.S. delivery business.

reasons.label: Raised full-year outlook
reasons.text: UPS lifted 2026 profit guidance to about $7.28 per share and revenue to about $92.6B.

reasons.label: U.S. profit margin improving
reasons.text: U.S. delivery margin rose to 7.0% from 6.4% as revenue per package climbed 6.1%.

reasons.label: Revenue grew everywhere
reasons.text: Sales rose 6.7% to $22.9B, with every segment growing and Q4 guided higher.

reports.verdict: Shares rose as Royal Caribbean beat estimates, raised its yearly profit forecast, and 2027 bookings looked strong.

reasons.label: Raised profit forecast
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted earnings per share forecast raised to $17.85–$17.95 after a $6.57 third quarter.

reasons.label: Strong 2027 bookings
reasons.text: 2027 bookings are up in the high teens, and booking volumes rose in the mid-teens.

reasons.label: Beat on demand, costs
reasons.text: Late bookings beat guidance, and some costs shifted into Q4, which flattered Q3.

reports.verdict: Record revenue, but a small miss and cooling trading volumes disappointed.

reasons.label: Revenue slightly missed
reasons.text: Revenue of $1.42B came in about 2% below the $1.43B forecast.

reasons.label: Crypto revenue plunged
reasons.text: Crypto revenue fell 55% to $120M as trading volume dropped 38%.

reasons.label: Early Q4 cooling
reasons.text: October trading volumes ran slightly below Q3 records, and the CFO said spreads were tighter.

reports.verdict: Investors liked a profit beat and a higher full-year outlook; shares rose modestly.

reasons.label: Raised profit outlook
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EPS guidance rose to about $5.60 from about $5.38 in July.

reasons.label: Earnings growth returns
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS rose 8% to $1.45 on revenue up 2% to $8.6B.

reasons.label: Heavy buybacks
reasons.text: PayPal bought back $1.5B of stock in the quarter, about $6.0B over 12 months.

reports.verdict: Solid beat and raised outlook, but weak U.S. demand and restaurant pressure kept shares lower.

reasons.label: Flat North America volume
reasons.text: U.S. and Canada volume was flat, down from 3% growth last quarter.

reasons.label: Restaurant pressure to persist
reasons.text: CFO says restaurant weakness continues into 2027; at-home drinking beats away-from-home.

reasons.label: Growth reliant on overseas
reasons.text: Global volume rose 5% and organic revenue 7%, driven by international markets.

reports.verdict: Solid beat, but cautious 2027 outlook and rising bank payments left the stock about flat.

reasons.label: Cooler 2027 outlook
reasons.text: Visa guided to low-double-digit revenue growth next year, versus 15% this year; some investors found that modest.

reasons.label: Rising payments to banks
reasons.text: Payments to banks and partners to keep them on Visa jumped 21% to $5.1B; about 25% of volume renews in 2027.

reasons.label: Costs growing faster
reasons.text: Adjusted operating expenses rose 12%, mostly marketing and staff, and 2027 profit growth is guided slightly below revenue growth.

reports.verdict: Earnings beat Nucor's own forecast and the outlook held up, so shares rose.

reasons.label: Beat own forecast
reasons.text: Earnings of $5.80 per share topped the $5.55-$5.65 range Nucor gave in September.

reasons.label: Higher steel prices
reasons.text: Average selling price rose 9% from last quarter to $1,493 per ton, lifting profit.

reasons.label: Steady outlook
reasons.text: Management expects fourth-quarter earnings flat to modestly higher, despite fewer shipping days and planned outages.

reports.verdict: Revenue missed estimates, so the stock fell despite a strong customer quarter and raised guidance.

reasons.label: Revenue missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $34.31B fell short of the ~$34.77B expected; phone upgrade sales dropped 9%.

reasons.label: Big customer gains priced in
reasons.text: 406,000 new phone customers beat the ~195,000 expected, but shares still slipped.

reasons.label: Raised outlook not enough
reasons.text: Full-year profit-per-share growth guidance rose to 7–7.5%, from 6–7%, yet the stock fell.
